constants.source: liu9_binding.solve_equation_parameters(360); the x* root was independently re-solved from z^4-2z^3+3z^2-1=0.

verification_D_at_xstar.round_off_scale_note: |D(x*,x*)| at dps 340 is at mpmath round-off level; the 12-digit perturbation moves it to a genuinely small value, consistent with an exact zero.

p_kernel.global_min_claim: unique interior local minimum => global min over [0,1]^2 (boundary values are exact 0 or positive)
p_kernel.main_reported_DISCOVERY: -0.06930259908 at (0.68,0.68): consistent with evaluating at the rounded point 0.68 instead of the argmin 0.680688509846... (gap ~ 2.6e-7 = 0.5*P''*(6.9e-4)^2)

p_negative_region.boundary_of_square: P(u,0)=P(0,v)=0 identically; P(1,v)=P(u,1)=h(.)*((1-beta)-1/(2m)) >= 0, so N is compactly contained in the open square
p_negative_region.meaning: On {s=tau=0}: Psi(0,t,sig,0) = P(t,sig) exactly, so {Psi<0} on that stratum = N exactly.  Same on {t=sigma=0} with the pair (s,tau).  Every Psi<0 point must have (s,tau) in N or (t,sig) in N, because Q >= 0 and a sum of two nonnegative P values cannot be negative.

d_kernel_zeros_hessian.verdict: nondegenerate minimum (Hessian positive definite; the zero at (x*,x*) is an isolated quadratic touch, NOT a flat or higher-order tangency)

d_corner_asymptotics.sign_verdict: leading coefficient positive for small a,b: D>0 near (1,1) transverse directions; the (1,1) zero is approached from positive values

psi_corners.claim: all 16 corners of [0,1]^4 are exact zeros of Psi

psi_global_min.method: seeded scipy differential_evolution (seed=SEED+1, popsize 40, maxiter 600, deferred, workers=-1) + 20480 Sobol starts with vectorized axis-compass descent + Nelder-Mead polish on top 128 (float64, DISCOVERY) -> mpmath dps-60 compass polish of deduplicated finalists -> dps-340 certification of winner
psi_global_min.orbit_symmetry_note: Psi(s,t,sig,tau) = Psi(t,s,ta,sg): (s,tau)<->(t,sig) swap; the four special strata are one orbit

r_threshold.definition: r* = crossing of min over [r,1-r]^4 of Psi through 0 (minval continuous & nondecreasing in r)
r_threshold.note: every negative point has at least one coordinate outside [r*, 1-r*]; interior-restricted reductions are safe iff their domain matches this box (magnitude of r* matters)

r_threshold_refined.method: Newton at dps 340 on {d phi/dz = 0, phi = 0} with phi(r,z) = P(r,r) + P(z,z) + 2 Q(r,z), the value of Psi on the active stratum s=tau=r, t=sigma=z

interior_tangency.reason: Psi(u,u,u,u) = (2/m) D_m(u,u) by Claim 3, and D_m(x*,x*) = 0 exactly because Liu's quartic x^4-2x^3+3x^2-1 = 0 forces pi(x*,x*) = 1-x*^2, hence h(pi(x*,x*)) = h(x*^2)

r_threshold_refined.claim: Psi >= 0 on [r,1-r]^4 exactly for r >= r*, and Psi attains strictly negative values inside [r,1-r]^4 for every r < r*. For r* <= r <= 1-x* the bound is TIGHT: the box minimum is exactly 0, attained at the interior point (x*,x*,x*,x*); it becomes strictly positive only for r > 1-x*.

sig_s_tau_t.attained: 0 at (x*,x*) (interior tangency of D) and on the zero lines {s=0},{t=0},{(1,1)}; the family is exactly (2/m)*D_m >= 0

sig_t_tau_s.note: on the diagonal this family equals 2D(u,u)/m >= 0

sign_verdicts.wedge_at_(0,z2,z2,0): Psi = P_min + 2 beta h(pi(e,z2)) + P(e,e); increases like ~ +0.18 e|ln e|; negative region is a cusp wedge on the s=tau=0 stratum

mutations.mutation: split with Q(s,t) replaced by Q(s,tau)

four_special_strata.s=0,tau=0: Psi == P(t,sig) exactly: negative exactly on {P<0}
four_special_strata.t=0,sigma=0: Psi == P(s,tau) exactly: negative exactly on {P<0}
